captions.linkedin:
Visit as a customer, not as the owner.

A brand with more than one location lives or dies on whether every store feels familiar. My audit checks four things: name and message, the space, the service standard, and pricing and promotions. Look, compare, fix.

The six points: name used the same way, message matches in all channels, signage matches, service standard followed, pricing logic consistent, customer feedback reviewed.

#Branding #Operations

Which point would your locations fail first?
